applications.description: Redevelopment of the Site to provide a four storey building comprising 9 no. self-contained residential flats (Use class C3), including 1 no. M4(3) unit, along with soft and hard landscaping.

game.plainAsk: Knock the site down and put up a 4-storey block of 9 flats. and one is built for a wheelchair user.
game.plainImpact: Nine extra homes, but The application doesn't say how many would be social homes. This is under 10 homes so they dodge the usual affordable rule. Neighbours get a new block;

applications.description: Demolition of existing building. Erection of part 8, part 7 and part 6-storey building comprising residential units (Use Class C3) and commercial space (Flexible Use Class E/Sui Generis [Recording Studio]), with associated amenity and play space, accessible car parking, cycle parking, landscaping, changes to existing access points and other associated works.

game.plainAsk: Knock the building down and put up a part-8, part-7, part-6 storey block of homes, plus shops, offices and a recording studio, with play space.
game.plainImpact: A major in Wapping (36 homes on the desk). Social housing is not stated on this application. St Paul's Whitechapel school is within 400 m; Royal London is in the 400–1,200 m sweet spot. Borough fact: Tower Hamlets has 3,096 households in temporary accommodation.

applications.description: Demolition of existing buildings and redevelopment of the site to provide a residential development, comprising 65 dwellings, plus disabled car parking spaces, cycle parking, refuse/recycling facilities and access together with landscaping including communal and private amenity space, and associated development.Minor Material Amendments to Planning permission Ref: PA/21/02746, Dated 09/12/2022: Amendments include: Change the tenure of unit C.01 from Affordable Rented to Private. Change Units A09 and A10 (currently both 2 bed units) to 1x1B and 1x3B.
applications.site_name: Langdon Park Community Centre And Land At Rear, St Leonards Road, London

game.plainAsk: They already have permission for 65 homes with 16 affordable homes (11 affordable rent and 5 intermediate) — about 25% of homes, or 36% by habitable room. This change would remove 1 affordable-rent home.
game.plainImpact: The parent permission is 16 affordable homes. This s73 would lose 1 affordable-rent home. It is not a 35% London Plan default. Housing Delivery Test 2025 (published 17 August 2026): 47% Presumption. The borough needed 11,698 homes and delivered 5,501. Below 75% means new housing is harder for the council to refuse. Tower Hamlets has 3,096 households in temporary accommodation (31 March 2026).
